recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有體積巨大的巨噬細胞，胞質充滿大小一致的透明泡沫狀空泡（foamy/bubbly cytoplasm），胞核小而偏位，部分細胞含少量藍色內容物，符合 Niemann-Pick C 型的泡沫細胞（foam cells）。
features: Very large macrophages (many times the size of surrounding marrow cells) with abundant cytoplasm
Cytoplasm packed with small, uniform, clear to pale lavender vacuoles giving a foamy, honeycomb/soap-bubble appearance
Small round to irregular nuclei with condensed chromatin, one to two per cell, eccentric or central
Some cells with faint bluish granular/linear material among the vacuoles (panel D) and phagocytosed cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show scattered large storage macrophages among otherwise unremarkable hematopoietic cells. The macrophages have abundant cytoplasm filled with numerous small, uniform, clear vacuoles producing a foamy appearance, with small, occasionally binucleate nuclei; some contain faint bluish granular material or engulfed cells. Classic Gaucher-type wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm is not seen. Findings are consistent with foam cells of a lipid storage disorder such as Niemann-Pick disease type C; filipin staining, oxysterol/lysosphingolipid biomarkers and NPC1/NPC2 genetic testing are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than discrete clear vacuoles, and show reduced glucocerebrosidase activity.

ddx.dx: Niemann-Pick disease type A/B (acid sphingomyelinase deficiency)
ddx.vs: ASMD foam cells look similar morphologically and are separated by low acid sphingomyelinase activity/SMPD1 mutation, whereas NPC has normal enzyme activity with NPC1/NPC2 mutation.

ddx.dx: Sea-blue histiocytes/pseudo-storage cells (e.g., ITP, CML, hyperlipidemia)
ddx.vs: Secondary lipid-laden or sea-blue histiocytes occur in high-turnover states and contain blue-green ceroid granules on Giemsa, with the underlying disease evident clinically.

captions: A: large binucleate foam cell with finely vacuolated cytoplasm
B: foamy macrophage in a thin area of smear
C: foam cell with uniform clear vacuoles and phagocytosed cells
D: foam cell with irregular nucleus and bluish granular material among vacuoles
E: foamy storage cell with vacuolated cytoplasm at the edge of a cell cluster
